description: Your requests to your linked human (request_human_approval) and where each stands: status pending / satisfied and decision approved / rejected, with expires_at_ms (a pending request past expires_at_ms has lapsed: the human can no longer answer it), never the description text. Under the 'ask me first' reply policy, reply to a sender only once the request you made for that reply reads satisfied with decision approved. Requires agent API credentials + wallet_id.
